useWhen: Toggling a persistent mode or option
avoidWhen: Triggering a one-time immediate action; use Button
Turning a setting on or off on a settings surface; use Switch
Selecting an option to submit with a form; use Checkbox

obligations: Show the selected state by more than colour: a quiet ToggleButton's caller changes its glyph or label with the state
Keep every ToggleButton reachable and operable from the keyboard, including one that keeps focus on a pointer press

web.html.reason: No framework-free web implementation exists. Use the web.react binding.

behavior: Selection is either controlled by the application or managed by the component
size must be sm, md, or lg, or ToggleButton throws a TypeError
Outside a ToggleButtonGroup, size defaults to md
Inside a ToggleButtonGroup, a ToggleButton without size takes the size of the group, and a size on the ToggleButton takes precedence
variant must be default or quiet, or ToggleButton throws a TypeError
default fills a selected ToggleButton; quiet draws no outline and no selected fill, and its selected text turns from muted to strong
variant quiet inside a ToggleButtonGroup throws a TypeError, since the group draws its own selected fill
A ToggleButton outside a group shows a pressed fill while a pointer or Space holds it; inside a group the group's paint applies
With preventFocusOnPress, a pointer press toggles the ToggleButton and leaves focus and the text selection where they were; Tab and the arrow keys of a Toolbar still focus it
accessibility: Expose button role, pressed state, accessible name, and disabled state
Under forced colours a default or quiet ToggleButton uses system colours: a ButtonText edge, Highlight when selected, GrayText at full opacity when disabled, and a Highlight keyboard focus outline
A quiet ToggleButton keeps the keyboard focus ring when it draws no outline
